rules: When model is supplied, update React state with onChange(nextModel); the library does not mutate the caller's model object. Without model, Form keeps an internal model.
FormItem prop selects a model field; supported child controls receive the field value and change handler automatically.
onSubmit receives { valid }, not a DOM submit event. Save only when valid is true. Button htmlType=submit triggers validation.
disabled and readOnly are inherited by supported form controls; explicit child props override inherited state.
reset clears registered fields to null and emits onChange/onReset; it does not restore an original snapshot.
Use inside Form. prop is the field path, not the field value. Do not copy Vue v-model bindings.
Use value and onChange(nextValue). onChange receives a string, not a DOM event.

Input uses synchronized local state: edits can stay local until the parent supplies a different value. Do not promise strict native controlled-input semantics. Keep application state updated through onChange.
Use htmlType=submit/reset for form actions; type is visual intent, not native button type.

Button.icon takes IconType[] data imported from kui-icons: import { Search } from 'kui-icons'; use <Button icon={Search} />. Never pass a JSX element (<Icon type={Search} />), a component function, or an icon-name string to icon. For custom rendered content, put <Icon type={Search} /> in Button children. Input prefix/suffix are renderable nodes and must not be confused with Button.icon.
Use checked and onChange. checked initializes local state; interactions update it internally, and changed checked props synchronize it.
checked is boolean. onChange returns boolean/string/number according to valueType; default valueType is boolean.
Use open and onOpenChange. open initializes local visibility; interactions update it internally, and changed open props synchronize it.
onOk does not automatically save or close. Validate/save first, then set open=false. loading blocks user dismissal during saving.
Use children or content and footer props, not Vue named slots.
Use open and onOpenChange. open initializes local visibility, allows interaction, and synchronizes changed props. Do not use v-model.
Pages are one-based. onChange(page, pageSize) reports both values. Update application page/pageSize state and fetch data explicitly.
Pass data and columns. Set rowKey to a stable unique field; the default is key.
The component does not call your backend. For remote paging, combine Page with explicit loading/error state and protect against stale responses.
Use render callbacks/ReactNode props from the API; Vue slot syntax is invalid.
Use selectedKeys or value with onChange for selection; openKeys with onOpenChange controls expanded submenus. Do not use Vue update events.
Wrap children to supply locale, size, theme and shape. Explicit component props override provider values. Import locales from react-kui/locale/<locale>.
Use value and onChange(value), not v-model. Multiple selection uses an array.
onSelect(option) supplies the selected option and selected flag; onChange does not supply an option as a second argument.
The public React export is KImage, not the Vue Image component name.
Use children and compact. Vertical compact layout supports Button groups. Use className, not class.
children is the trigger; overlay supplies popup content. Do not place the menu in children as a translation of the Vue overlay slot.
Use value/onChange for a single date or a range array when the selected mode is a range. startDate/endDate with onStartDateChange/onEndDateChange are an alternative binding channel, not the only API.
onChange receives (date, dateStr); output depends on valueType and mode. Handle clear/null values explicitly and avoid supplying conflicting binding channels.
Use checked for the checked state; value identifies an item in a CheckboxGroup. onChange receives an object with checked and optional value/label, not the Switch scalar callback.
Use children for the trigger and overlay for the popup content. open/onOpenChange synchronizes visibility; query the callback detail type for dismissal reasons.
The shared Popup manages nested layers; do not implement an extra document-click closer that can close parent pickers during nested selections.
Use itemKey to identify the menu item. React key alone is not forwarded as itemKey.
